entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Príamo Pericles Tejeda Rosario was a Dominican Roman Catholic prelate. He was auxiliary bishop of Santo Domingo and titular of Gilba from 1975 to 1986 and first bishop of Baní from 1986 to 1997.
